text:
A light ray strikes a plane mirror and is reflected.
Which angle is always equal in size to the angle of reflection?
A
the angle between the incident ray and the mirror
B
the angle between the incident ray and the normal to the mirror
C
the angle between the reflected ray and the mirror
D
the angle between the reflected ray and the incident ray

options.label: A
options.text: the angle between the incident ray and the mirror

options.label: B
options.text: the angle between the incident ray and the normal to the mirror

options.label: C
options.text: the angle between the reflected ray and the mirror

options.label: D
options.text: the angle between the reflected ray and the incident ray

subject: Physics
